proofs.text: Run the command with `--help`, with `login --nope` and with no argument; verify the exit codes are 0, 2 and 2

reasons: PROOF-28 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: `approve.py --help` exits 0 and an unknown option or no feature at all exits 2

tests.body:
def test_help_exits_zero_and_a_bad_option_exits_two(self):
        assert approve_module.main(['--help']) == 0
        assert approve_module.main(['login', '--nope']) == 2
        assert approve_module.main([]) == 2
tests.name: test_help_exits_zero_and_a_bad_option_exits_two
